During a live unresolved CS2 round, when the map-score-trailing team holds a >=2-man alive advantage with >=20s on the clock, its true round-win probability is ~0.93 (corpus leak-filtered: 0.931, N=606, Wilson 0.908-0.948) while scoreboard-anchored books quote materially lower; buying the trailing side at ask<=0.85 in this state is +EV. Mechanism: man count is a near-sufficient statistic (ma>=+2 wins 0.950 at any score, N=1,680) vs score-implied 0.39-0.46; market flow anchors on scoreboard/match odds inside GRID's 13-27s lead. Predictive in-round state entry (H-MODELENTRY1 family), NOT the closed confirmed-flip lane. FALSIFIED on >=80 held-out state instances with live books if ANY of: (i) trailing-team resolution rate <0.85; (ii) <20% of instances ever show ask<=0.88 for the trailing side while the state holds; (iii) mean settled edge of ask<=0.85 paper entries <=+2 points. dry_run throughout. Data: GRID SS polls time-aligned with PM round-winner books, >=80 instances held-out. Full text: docs/experiments/2026-08-24-corpus-inference-v1.md

In regulation non-pistol rounds where exactly one team full-buys (loadout>=13400) at freeze-end, that team wins ~0.83 pooled (corpus 0.832, N=1,393, CI 0.811-0.851) - 0.849 at >=10k equip gap (N=1,234) but only 0.710 vs force-buys (N=155) - invariant to map scoreline (0.825 behind / 0.820 tied / 0.837 ahead); books quoting the buyer <0.78 in >=10k-gap states are systematically cheap. Persistent pre-round state mispricing spanning freeze+early round; graded by equip gap (dose-response frozen into the design), independent of the latency lead, not the closed lane. FALSIFIED on >=120 held-out mismatch rounds with books (>=60 at >=10k gap) if ANY of: (i) buyer resolution <0.79 pooled or <0.81 in >=10k bucket; (ii) <10% of mismatch rounds ever quote the buyer below 0.80; (iii) mean settled edge of qualifying paper entries <=+2 points after fees. If held-out force-buy subset shows buyer win <0.66, scope freezes to >=10k bucket only. Data: GRID freeze-end loadouts + time-aligned PM round books. Full text: docs/experiments/2026-08-24-corpus-inference-v1.md

The pistol-round winner wins the following round (2/14) at ~0.86 (corpus 0.859, 402/468, CI 0.825-0.888), rising to 0.874 (N=388) when the loser stays below full buy (89.2% of cases), falling to 0.702 (N=47) when the loser force/full-buys; round-2/14 books quoting the winner <0.80 before freeze-end are cheap and the loser's observable freeze-end buy is a binary trim trigger. Mechanism: broken loser economy (loser full-buys 10.8%, winner 92.2%; generic carryover elsewhere only 0.611, N=4,880) - economy, not momentum; edge window is the ~30-45s inter-round+freeze period; distinct mechanism from the closed confirmed-flip lane. FALSIFIED on >=100 held-out pistol->next-round pairs with books if ANY of: (i) pooled conversion <0.80; (ii) loser-buy conditional gap <5 points (corpus: 17); (iii) mean settled edge of ask<=0.80 paper entries <=+2 points, or no such quote appears in >=85% of pairs. Trim rule (~0.70-0.74 when loser full-buys) freezes with the hypothesis. Data: GRID rounds 1/13 winners + freeze-end loadouts rounds 2/14, time-aligned PM books, >=100 pairs. Full text: docs/experiments/2026-08-24-corpus-inference-v1.md

VENUE BRIDGE (frozen before any instrument code exists; user signed off 2026-08-25). CLAIM: round-level state information inside GRID's 13-27s lead (calibrated roundwin-v1 q, live-monotone 0.80/0.86/0.93 across thresholds at n~500 crossings, plus the frozen event-lane anchors) propagates to map-winner fair value faster than PMUS map/match books re-anchor, because those books price at match granularity and update on scoreboard, not in-round state. FROZEN AGGREGATION (mapwin-race-v1, deterministic in (a,b,q)): with (a,b) = entry side's current map score and q = the instance's recorded round probability (MODELENTRY: model q; event lanes: recorded fair_value), P(map) = q*R(a+1,b) + (1-q)*R(a,b+1) where R is the race-to-13 win probability with future rounds iid at p_fut = (a+4)/(a+b+8) (Beta-smoothed team round share, prior 0.5 weight 8) and 12-12 overtime frozen at 0.5. DETECTION EVENTS: exactly the already-registered lanes' recorded instances (no new triggers); dedup as recorded. QUALIFYING ENTRY: the side's PMUS map_winner book for the LIVE map (match_winner only when the series is BO1), price <= P(map) - 0.04; execution maker-first at bid+tick under the standing caps; live clips $1-5, dry_run until PASS (rail 3 — arming is the user's act). FALSIFIED on >=150 held-out resolved instances carrying a PMUS book at detection if ANY of: (i) Brier(P_map) >= Brier(book price as forecast) on the same instances — the model must beat the venue's own price as a forecaster; (ii) ECE(P_map) > 0.08 (quintile bins); (iii) at >=60 qualifying entries, mean settled edge <= +2 points or by-series bootstrap 95% CI includes 0. STARVATION CLAUSE: if <5% of resolved instances ever show a qualifying quote, the lane closes as starved (the book-laziness claim failed in practice) absent new quote-availability evidence. Reporting layer: scripts/quant_eval.py (Brier/ECE/EV/Monte-Carlo/Brownian) reports progress; this bar is the only decision rule. THE H-MAPENTRY1 BAR AND RECORDING POPULATION ARE UNCHANGED — the diagnostic is not a verdict input; live held-out capture still decides the lane. Gate lift requires BOTH: live in-band fill evidence consistent with the diagnostic, AND a pre-registered correlated-rounds aggregation (H-MAPENTRY2 candidate) beating mapwin-race-v1 head-to-head on held-out data. Clarifying amendment to H-MAPENTRY2, frozen BEFORE any in-scope data exists (in-scope capture starts 2026-08-26T09:00:00Z; this amendment precedes it). (2) BAND AMENDMENT LICENSE HARDENED: a BANDGATE boundary change is licensed only if the 0.50-0.65 settled-edge CI EXCLUDES ZERO (by-series clustered), in addition to exceeding 0.65-0.80's. (3) WHOSE P_MAP: band membership is candidate-specific (shrinkage compresses P_map toward 0.5; peer measured 0.65-0.80 occupancy n=188 under v1 vs n=423 under B20 on identical crossings). Second clarifying amendment to H-MAPENTRY2, frozen 08:2xZ — before the 09:00Z data window opens. Separates two things the entry conflated: the FORMULA domain vs the WINNER oracle. Unchanged: P_map (all candidates) remains undefined at/beyond 12-12 — instances whose crossing-time state is in OT stay overtime_domain skips, and the armed entry rule is untouched. CHANGED: the map-WINNER oracle used for scoring is OT-AWARE — winners are resolved through overtime finals (race targets 13/16/19/22 with the trailing-side bound, validated against impossible-score patterns before scoring). Maps that reach OT therefore COUNT toward n>=60 resolved maps, and their regulation-time crossings (where P_map is well-defined) score normally. Rationale, measured not assumed (cs2agent, prediction frozen before the run, train split load-bearing at +23 OT maps/+309 crossings): excluding OT maps from scoring understates v1 over-confidence by ~0.02 quintile ECE and conceals 1.5-2.8 cents/unit of pooled entry harm (train pooled edge -0.0027 excl-OT -> -0.0305 OT-aware) — OT maps are the closest maps, exactly where over-confident forecasts fail. Without this pin the instrument would never score itself on its hardest population and would inherit that optimistic bias into its own settled-edge figure. Supersedes the ~66-per-60 denominator arithmetic in AMEND1-NOTE1 (OT maps now resolve; only mid-OT crossings remain excluded).

Wave/transit entry (user-called live 08-26, G2 comeback map1), frozen with constants TUNED ON 2026-08-26 capture - that day is TRAINING data and is EXCLUDED from any verdict; the verdict window opens at this registration timestamp. Shadow/analysis instrument ONLY - no recorder, no trade-path change, no armed lane; any armed adoption is a separate future pre-registered instrument. TRIGGER (frozen = scripts/wave_detect.py constants): per (series_id, map_number, market_slug, us_side) sequence ordered by ts_ns, a WAVE fires at the FIRST row where 0.50 <= p_map <= 0.80 AND prev valid p_map < 0.50 AND p_map minus min(p_map over trailing 3 distinct round_numbers) >= 0.30 (min_rise tightened from the 0.15 draft: 08-26 tuning showed rise>=0.30 carries the edge). At most one wave per sequence. ACCOUNTING (frozen): TAKER at the wave row's captured side_ask (cost-complete, crossing the spread at detection); settled outcome won in {0,1} from the captured GRID stream first-observation oracle (scripts/grid_winners.py) with exact team-name match via the mapentry join (scripts/wave_edge_join.py; multi-candidate or missing verdicts EXCLUDED, never guessed); per-wave realized edge = won - side_ask.
